saw_lines: Shoppers buy jeans by fit, come back to the same cut once it works, so the first order is the hard part.
So the sale is won in the first line, where a new buyer decides if the offer is worth a click.
Your site offers 10% off your first order, yet 0 of 21 ads mention it. Put that offer in line one of three new ads and on the creative.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 14 Oct 2026
points: Your site offers 10% off your first order, yet 0 of 21 ads mention it, so a new buyer has no reason to act today. Put that offer in line one of three new ads and on the creative itself.
Your site explains shipping on its own page, but 0 of 30 ads mention shipping or delivery, so a new buyer has no answer in the feed. Open ads for new buyers with the delivery answer in line one.

None of your 30 ads shows a proof number, so buyers have nothing concrete to trust before they click. Collect one real figure, such as a review count or orders shipped, and lead three ads with it on the creative.

7 Shop now ads send buyers to the homepage, so the click lands on a general page with no next step. Point each of those ads to the product or collection its creative shows, so buyers see the item they clicked.
